item.explanation:
WHAT CHANGED: Tesla added that third-party commentary has incited protests, some escalating to violence targeting its operations, products and personnel, and expanded its discussion of confidence risks.
WHY IT MATTERS: Violence targeting Tesla has already occurred. The filing also says negative perceptions may harm its brand and business, including sales, though it does not quantify that impact.
IMPORTANCE: high - realized: Violence targeting Tesla
EVIDENCE: "has incited protests, some escalating to violence targeting our operations, products and personnel"; "may harm our brand and our business (including sales)"
